references.text: Light and glory that covers the earth and draws the nations can be seen as a parallel to the universal visibility of the coming of the Son of Man.
Daniel's vision of the Son of Man coming with the clouds can be connected with the universal and manifest nature of Jesus' return.
The day of the Lord comes like a thief, which emphasizes the sudden and unexpected nature of Jesus' return, even though the context is somewhat different.
Jesus' return is described as visible to all, like lightning that flashes across the sky from east to west.
